title: Digital Dybbuks and Virtual Golems: The Ethics of Digital Duplicates in Holocaust Testimony
reasoning: The entire paper is a normative ethical analysis applying the 'Minimally Viable Permissibility Principle' (MVPP) to the creation of AI digital duplicates of Holocaust survivors. It explores moral obligations, deontology, and the ethical implications of using generative AI for trauma memory, while also incorporating Jewish theological folklore (Golems and Dybbuks) as ethical frameworks.
